meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入产品链接或脚本文案,自动生成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想把产品链接快速变成一支宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a promo video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn your product page into a promo video.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude会把一个产品链接、粘贴的脚本或简报,变成一支产品发布/推广视频。它会抓取页面素材、分析品牌、设计画面,编写故事板和旁白,并逐帧生成,最终渲染成 MP4 视频文件。
howto.when: 当你提出想推广、发布或宣传某个产品,给出商业网址或粘贴脚本/简报,或要求做网站导览/展示时触发。意图不明确时,会先交给 /hyperframes 判断。

say.text: 把这个产品官网做成一支推广视频
say.note: Claude会按流程抓取页面并生成视频

say.text: 根据这段发布文案脚本,做一支产品演示视频
say.note: 脚本会作为旁白素材用于视频

say.text: 给我的新应用做一个展示视频,按原样呈现网站
say.note: 会走网站导览流程,用真实截图制作

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude turns a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch/promo video. It captures page assets, analyzes brand, designs visuals, writes storyboard & narration, generates frames, and renders an MP4 video file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product — e.g. a commercial URL, pasted script/brief, or a site tour/showcase request. If unclear, it defers to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make a promo video from this product website
say_en.note: Claude will capture the site and generate the video

say_en.text: Create a product demo video from this launch script
say_en.note: The script is used as narration material

say_en.text: Make a showcase video for my app, showing the site as-is
say_en.note: Runs the site-tour flow with real screenshots
